name: T20 Audit: recount the published result in the browser
description: The browser downloads the cast-vote record, hashes it and counts it again; the result matches what was published.

planSteps.description: Click the "Recount in your browser" button
Wait until the recount result appears
The page shows a line starting with "Recount matches: same winner, same 2 rounds, CVR SHA-256"
